title: Settings
intro: Manage your profile, notifications and account

profile.logoHelp: It will appear in the header of generated PDFs.

notifications.measurementsIntro: When a linked client measures from their own app you can be notified by email, with a direct link to the recording.

modes.subitoDesc: One email as soon as the client measures. At most one per client per hour.
modes.riepilogoDesc: A single email per day with all measurements, grouped by client.
modes.maiDesc: No email. Measurements stay visible in the client records anyway.

notifications.timezoneHelp: The digest time is read in this time zone.
notifications.emailOverridePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the account email
notifications.emailOverrideInvalid: The alternative email is not valid.
notifications.weeklySummaryDesc: Receive a summary of your activity every week
notifications.alertEmailsDesc: Receive an email every time a high-severity alert is generated
notifications.marketingDesc: Updates on new Stress Index features

account.emailHelp: To change your email contact us at hello@stressindex.io
account.passwordTooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters
account.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
account.subscriptionHelp: For management and billing contact us at hello@stressindex.io
account.dangerHelp: Deleting the account removes all associated data.
account.deleteNotice: To permanently delete your account contact us at hello@stressindex.io. For now you will only be signed out.
